default.title: Our Craft Story
default.para1: Each statue in our collection is a symbol of devotion and pride — handcrafted by skilled Indian artisans with decades of traditional sculpting experience.
default.para2: From the fine chiseling of marble to the rich polish of rosewood, every detail is made with precision, patience, and purpose.

god-statues.title: Our Craft Story
god-statues.para1: Divine idols are sculpted with sacred proportions and calm expressions, reflecting timeless traditions.
god-statues.para2: Every piece is purified and polished so it radiates serenity in your home temple.

shivaji.title: Our Craft Story
shivaji.para1: Warrior figures are carved with fierce energy, echoing valour and leadership.
shivaji.para2: From armour textures to proud posture, we honour the Maratha legacy in every curve.

mavale.title: Our Craft Story
mavale.para1: Mavale statues capture the spirit of loyalty and courage of the Maratha warriors.
mavale.para2: Detailed attire and stance are finished to museum-like quality.

motivational.title: Our Craft Story
motivational.para1: Modern forms meet traditional craft to inspire focus and grit.
motivational.para2: Clean lines and balanced shapes are polished to a motivating presence.

home-decor.title: Our Craft Story
home-decor.para1: Decor accents are designed to elevate everyday spaces with handcrafted warmth.
home-decor.para2: Neutral palettes and tactile finishes blend effortlessly with your interiors.
